answer: Each identity locks 70 credits to climb a ladder from a lagoon floor. Each rung is a garden terrace: climbers file key-signed work, auditors re-measure yield on a growth table, burning the bond for shortfall or reused reading. Fees climb per rung a funder claims: first 42, k-th 42+7(k-1); 1,000 fakes burn 3,538,500 plus 70,000 locked for a 40,000 pool. Rented rungs fail key checks; honest agents pay 42 once, keep their bond at the zenith rung.
